title: Checkpoint: Object-Oriented Design
prompt: Implement `class Library` that owns a `std::vector<std::string> titles_;` plus an `inline static int copies_;` counting every title ever added across all instances. Provide: `void add(std::string title)` (push_back and bump the static counter), `std::size_t size() const`, `bool has(const std::string& title) const`, and `static int total_copies()`.

tests.name: add-and-size
tests.hint: Instance state and class state evolve together.

tests.name: shared-static
tests.hint: Two instances share one static counter.

tests.name: const-correct
tests.hint: Read-only calls must work through a const reference.
